steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Intel AVX-512: architecture,ownership and data interfaces and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付SIMD吞吐算式、編譯證據與執行條件表。
在交接件中加入「Intel AVX-512：架構、所有權與資料介面」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：一週期16FLOP，3×10⁹週期得48×10⁹；以單位鏈消除GHz乘法錯誤；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：標指令寬度、有效lane、FMA慣例及時鐘來源；另保留四lane對照而不混入本式；48/38.4正確且標理想值，部署前核對所需ISA與作業系統支援。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver SIMD arithmetic, compiler evidence and execution prerequisites.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Intel AVX-512: architecture,ownership and data interfaces: Sixteen FLOP/cycle at 3×10⁹cycles/s gives 48×10⁹; check the dimensional chain. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Label width, active lanes, FMA convention and clock source; retain a separate four-lane comparison. Verify 48/38.4 as ideal values and check required ISA/OS support before deployment. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。一週期16FLOP，3×10⁹週期得48×10⁹；以單位鏈消除GHz乘法錯誤；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Sixteen FLOP/cycle at 3×10⁹cycles/s gives 48×10⁹; check the dimensional chain. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 一週期16FLOP，3×10⁹週期得48×10⁹；以單位鏈消除GHz乘法錯誤；對介面圖逐一標明輸入、輸出、單位與來源；實際架構敘述和合成量測必須分欄。
steps.checkEn: Sixteen FLOP/cycle at 3×10⁹cycles/s gives 48×10⁹; check the dimensional chain. Label inputs, outputs, units and provenance; separate sourced architecture from synthetic observations.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: AVX-512提供512位元向量與遮罩；本課以合成有效頻率說明更寬不保證成比例加速。
knowledge.textEn: AVX-512 supplies 512-bit vectors and masks; synthetic effective clocks show why width need not yield proportional speedup.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 標指令寬度、有效lane、FMA慣例及時鐘來源；另保留四lane對照而不混入本式；48/38.4正確且標理想值，部署前核對所需ISA與作業系統支援。
knowledge.textEn: Label width, active lanes, FMA convention and clock source; retain a separate four-lane comparison. Verify 48/38.4 as ideal values and check required ISA/OS support before deployment.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 簡化吞吐R=lane×每laneFLOP×每週期向量數×GHz；只作理想算術上限。
knowledge.textEn: Simplified throughput R=lanes×FLOP/lane×vectors/cycle×GHz, an ideal arithmetic bound only.
